competencies: as-of monotonicity: a newer score is never regressed by a late stale computation
idempotent at-most-once dispatch keyed on a stable event id
half-open tumbling-window attribution (exactly one window, no double-count)
deterministic scoring reproducible from input events in any order
per-device monotonic sequence + unit normalization at the edge
layered architecture (core -> store -> services -> worker -> api)
deterministic testing with an injected clock
cannot_assess: a real time-series database or durable persistence (the stores are in-memory)
true multi-process / distributed stream processing and real watermark propagation across partitions (single-process; out-of-order is modelled by event_time, not by real parallel ingestion)
a real message broker or at-least-once delivery over a network (the outbox and retries are in-process) — distributed delivery is the design task's subject
authentication, authorization, consent and PHI encryption (not in this build)
real ML risk models (the score is a transparent, auditable rule engine, by design)
